dialogues.speaker: Shikanoin Heizou
dialogues.text: Hmm... Quite the slippery bunch. But there's no such thing as a deed that leaves no trace...

dialogues.speaker: Shikanoin Heizou
dialogues.text: I seem to have run into a minor snag. They're a bit sharper than I anticipated.

dialogues.speaker: Shikanoin Heizou
dialogues.text: Not only do they have a whole pile of middlemen who don't even know each other, but their sales channels are all one-way...

dialogues.speaker: Shikanoin Heizou
dialogues.text: Hmm... It's time to find a new angle...
